spine: Choose the explanatory question before the method; compare attribution, recourse and mechanism through falsifiable evidence, then carry that contract into agents and executable understanding.
art: An optical examination studio: navy and amber; lenses, controlled interventions, differently scoped windows and evidence layers, with no decorative neuron networks.
lines: Explainable AI treats explanations as claims that need evidence, rather than persuasive model narratives.
The book begins by asking what is being explained and who needs the answer.
A debugging engineer, affected person, and system owner may require different kinds of understanding.
Its distinctive treatment follows those differences through methods, validation, foundation models, and complete agent systems.
You will learn why an attractive heat map or rationale cannot certify itself.
The final chapters develop explanation contracts that another process can inspect and attempt to falsify.
